jei.yanscriptures.book.iliad.detail.2: · During the duel neither you nor your opponent can be weakened by attribute-lowering effects or blinded, nauseated, levitated, darkened, poisoned or withered.
jei.yanscriptures.book.iliad.detail.3: · Locked by 2 or more creatures: -10% attack damage, but every hit adds a random harmful effect at level II for 8 seconds.
jei.yanscriptures.book.iliad.detail.4: · While surrounded, every hit also deals 50% sweep damage to other enemies within 2.5 blocks.
jei.yanscriptures.book.aeneid.detail.1: · "Non-boss" means hostile + monster category + max health ≥ 150; undead means creatures whose vanilla attribute is undead (zombies, skeletons, phantoms, and anything another mod declares undead).
jei.yanscriptures.book.aeneid.detail.2: · Undead are neutral to you: when they retarget, picking you is cleared outright; but once you hit one yourself it fights back normally for 15 seconds.
jei.yanscriptures.book.aeneid.detail.3: · Counterattack for you: for 10 seconds after a non-undead hits you, undead within 16 blocks that carry no boss tag are sent after that creature.
jei.yanscriptures.book.aeneid.detail.4: · Inversion only applies to magic/wither damage with no attacker and to potion effects themselves; another player hitting you with a sword still hurts.
· Each level of Hero of the Village: +15% max health, +15% attack damage.
· Hold a sword, hold R for 5 seconds, release after the full 5 to fire.
· The slash runs 96 blocks along your line of sight and widens with distance; damage is 10000% of your attack damage.
· If the target has a damage cap, a follow-up of "actual health removed × 10" is added instead. 600 second cooldown.
· The whole cone the slash passes through (including empty space inside the ring) is carved out: stone, wood, leaves, grass, dirt, water and lava. Nothing drops.
jei.yanscriptures.book.analects.detail.1: · Counts within 16 blocks, only your own pets and minions, capped at 10 (other players and passive animals do not count).
jei.yanscriptures.book.analects.detail.2: · Damage bonus = 5% × number of pets and minions, applied directly to final damage.
jei.yanscriptures.book.analects.detail.3: · After each hit you heal 1% × number of pets and minions of your max health.
jei.yanscriptures.book.zhuangzi.detail.1: · Fall damage is zeroed outright, blocked once at the event layer and once at the damage-type layer.
jei.yanscriptures.book.zhuangzi.detail.2: · Hold Space in mid-air: falling speed never exceeds 0.08 blocks per tick; hold Shift to accelerate the fall further.
jei.yanscriptures.book.zhuangzi.detail.3: · +20% movement speed while gliding (elytra or glider).
jei.yanscriptures.book.zhuangzi.detail.4: · While gliding with an empty main hand, hold right-click to add a push along your line of sight every 4 ticks.
jei.yanscriptures.book.records_of_the_hi: · Each completed advancement adds a permanent stack of bonuses, kept even when the book is taken off.
· Crit rate and crit damage read the equipment system's crit attributes; without that mod these two do nothing.
· +0.2 luck per stack, stacking with the vanilla luck attribute.
jei.yanscriptures.book.thirty_six_strate: · Below 30% health you turn invisible for 6 seconds and movement speed ×2.
· While invisible you cannot be targeted at all: anything already locked on loses you at once, and new locks fail.
· 30 second cooldown; while worn, nearby creatures' detection range is another -35%.
jei.yanscriptures.book.on_war.detail.1: · Morale only counts damage taken, capped at max health × 20%.
jei.yanscriptures.book.on_war.detail.2: · The first hit at full morale: guaranteed crit plus extra true damage (ignores armor, enchantments and resistance).
jei.yanscriptures.book.on_war.detail.3: · Morale resets to zero after it fires; there is no cooldown — take enough damage again and it fires again.
jei.yanscriptures.book.on_war.detail.4: · Morale falls to zero 10 seconds after leaving combat.
jei.yanscriptures.book.de_revolutionibus: · The sun (gold), moon (silver) and earth (blue) form an equilateral triangle orbiting you horizontally: 10 second period, 1.5 block radius.
· Earth touching a creature: a random positive effect for 15 seconds; the same effect triggering again raises its level (up to IV).
· Moon touching an enemy: 20% attack damage plus a random harmful effect for 15 seconds; level I at noon, level V at midnight.
· Sun touching an enemy: 150% attack damage; 250% at noon, 50% at midnight, cosine-smoothed in between.
· The three bodies are real entities, not particles; they orbit you and follow you.
jei.yanscriptures.book.inner_canon_of_th: · Damage reduction = current health percentage - 50% (the fuller your health, the less it saves; at half health or below there is none).
· The reduction is settled when damage is taken and stacks with armor and resistance.
· The five phases rotate every 30 seconds, always in the order wood → fire → earth → metal → water.
· Rotation follows world time: putting the book on mid-cycle joins the current phase instead of restarting at wood.
jei.yanscriptures.book.wealth_of_nations: · Wealth only looks at the hotbar (9 slots) and inventory (27 slots); armor slots and offhand do not count.
· Counted by item id: the same id counts once no matter how many slots it fills.
· 11 kinds = 1 point, 22 kinds = 2 points, 33 or more = 3 points.
· All three effects are active at once; they do not overwrite each other.
jei.yanscriptures.book.hamlet.detail.1: · The four weights add up to 100%: 10% → 15% damage, 50% → 35% damage, 150% → 35% damage, 200% → 15% damage.
jei.yanscriptures.book.hamlet.detail.2: · Rolling the 10% bracket banks a "next hit always crits", spent on your next attack only.
jei.yanscriptures.book.hamlet.detail.3: · Rolling the 200% bracket resolves this hit as a crit outright.
